fib: ______ are the two equivalence points while point B and D are the half-neutralization points whose values equal pKa2 as pK1 respectively.
Point C and E

______ is a controllable and uncontrollable variation observed when comparing the measured values to the true value.
Error
Error is a controllable and uncontrollable variation observed when comparing the measured values to the true value.

EDTA

Electromagnetic radiation process

equivalent weight
